Portland Cement Association (2003). Canadian Portland Cement Industry Tables (2001 data; Labour Productivity, Energy Consumption, Energy Distribution, Waste Fuel Summary, Survey Methodology Notes), December 31, 2001 edition, file dated May 2003. PCA, Skokie IL. No report number or DOI.

Two files held for this one source: the base 7-page PDF (this stem) and an 8-page copy with an embedded 300 dpi scan on page 2 (stem-disaggregated.pdf). Their text layers are identical (checked by diff), so every number was read once. Page footers read "Page xx", so locators are PDF pages. 2001 is the Canadian edition of the annual PCA labour-energy survey (15 plants, grey cement only); the 2000 edition with plant-category summary reports (fuel and electricity separately, US and Canada) is pca_2002_001 and carries much more detail. Loaded: the three dry-process kiln categories published for 2001 (no preheater, precalciner, preheater/precalciner) as total energy per equivalent tonne (92% clinker + 8% cement, whole plant incl. electricity, LHV). Wet process and preheater-only categories are withheld for disclosure. Time series 1974-2001 in other-values. Labour productivity not loaded. No money values.
